description: Coverage register for the ARC-1 (tool, action) surface against the clean-core chain. An action is either used by an action-catalog.json operation or declared out of scope here with a reason. CI fails when the frozen tool fixtures expose an action that is in neither set — so an upstream release can never quietly add a capability the chain should have adopted (as happened with atc_variants and edit_unit in 0.9.27) — and equally when a pattern here stops matching anything, which means the register itself went stale. Patterns support a trailing '*'. Object types are deliberately out of the register: they grow with every ABAP type ARC-1 learns and carry no chain decision, whereas actions are capabilities.

outOfScope.SAP.*: Hyperfocused single-tool mode. Its 'actions' are the 12 tool names, not capabilities.
outOfScope.SAPGit.*: gCTS/abapGit repository delivery. The chain governs objects and transports; git delivery is the operator's pipeline.
outOfScope.SAPManage.flp_*: Fiori launchpad content (catalogs, groups, tiles). UI delivery, not Clean Core classification.
outOfScope.SAPDiagnose.sql_trace_*: ST05 SQL trace control. Performance investigation, delegated to debug-slow-sql.
outOfScope.SAPDiagnose.set_sql_trace_state: ST05 trace switching, and a system-wide write (it flips all instances) the chain must not make.
outOfScope.SAPDiagnose.trace_*: ABAP trace lifecycle. Performance investigation, delegated to debug-slow-sql.
outOfScope.SAPDiagnose.traces: Trace listing. Performance investigation, delegated to debug-slow-sql.
outOfScope.SAPDiagnose.odata_perf: OData performance probing, delegated to debug-slow-sql.
outOfScope.SAPDiagnose.cds_sql: Generated CDS SQL inspection, delegated to debug-slow-sql.
outOfScope.SAPDiagnose.cds_testcases: CDS test-case suggestions, delegated to generate-cds-unit-test.
outOfScope.SAPDiagnose.dumps: ST22 runtime dumps. Operator troubleshooting, not classification evidence.
outOfScope.SAPDiagnose.object_state: Source-state check. The chain reads sources and runs syntax checks on candidates instead.
outOfScope.SAPDiagnose.authorization_trace: Authorization tracing. A candidate for a future Level A authorization-evidence step; no current gate requires it.
outOfScope.SAPActivate.unpublish_srvb: Unpublishing a service binding is an operator retirement step; no chain action scripts it.
outOfScope.SAPContext.structure: Object outline. The chain reads sources and uses format=structured when it needs structure.
outOfScope.SAPLint.lint: Reporting-only lint. The chain lints candidates with lint_and_fix.
outOfScope.SAPLint.list_rules: Rule inventory. Lint configuration is an operator/repository concern.
outOfScope.SAPLint.set_formatter_settings: Formatter administration, and a system-wide write the chain must not make.
outOfScope.SAPManage.features: Capability probe. Step 1 uses SAPManage(probe), which reports the same feature set.
outOfScope.SAPManage.change_package: Package moves are planned by the chain but executed by the operator; no action mutates package assignment.
outOfScope.SAPManage.delete_package: Package deletion is an operator cleanup step, outside per-unit remediation.
outOfScope.SAPManage.cache_stats: ARC-1 cache introspection, not SAP evidence.
outOfScope.SAPNavigate.definition: Go-to-definition for interactive editing; the chain uses deps and references.
outOfScope.SAPTransport.get: Transport detail, delegated to sap-transport-overview and sap-transport-review.
outOfScope.SAPTransport.history: Object transport history, delegated to sap-transport-overview.
outOfScope.SAPTransport.release: The chain releases with release_recursive, which releases the tasks first.
outOfScope.SAPTransport.layers: Transport layer discovery for create; the chain lets the package resolve the route.
outOfScope.SAPTransport.targets: Transport target discovery; the chain does not set TR_TARGET.
outOfScope.SAPWrite.add_method: Class-section surgery. Available to rewrites, but the chain writes whole sources or single methods and does not script section-level refactors.
outOfScope.SAPWrite.delete_method: Class-section surgery, and destructive: it discards the method body.
outOfScope.SAPWrite.edit_text_symbols: Text symbols/textpool. On-prem only and irrelevant to Level A classification.
outOfScope.SAPWrite.generate_behavior_implementatio: RAP behavior generation, delegated to generate-rap-logic.
